1.text: Tumaze gutandukana na bo tugenda mu nkuge, turaromboreza tujya i Kosi. Bukeye bwaho dufata i Rodo, tuvayo dufata i Patara.

2.text: Dusanze inkuge yenda kwambuka ijya i Foyinike, tuyikiramo turatsuka turagenda.

3.text: Tugeze aho tureba i Kupuro, tuhasiga ibumoso bwacu tujya i Siriya, dufata i Tiro, kuko ari ho bashatse gukūrira imitwaro mu nkuge.

4.text: Tuhasanga abigishwa dusibirayo karindwi, na bo babwirijwe n'Umwuka babuza Pawulo kujya i Yerusalemu.

5.text: Tumaze iyo minsi tuvayo turagenda, bose baduherekeranya n'abagore n'abana baturenza umudugudu, dupfukama mu kibaya cy'inyanja turasenga.

6.text: Tumaze gusezeranaho twikira mu nkuge, na bo basubira iwabo.

7.text: Natwe turangije urugendo rwacu rwo kuva i Tiro, tugera i Putolemayi turamutsa bene Data, dusibira iwabo umunsi umwe.

8.text: Bukeye bwaho tuvayo tugera i Kayisariya, twinjira mu nzu ya Filipo umubwiriza w'ubutumwa bwiza, n'umwe muri ba bandi barindwi ducumbika iwe.

9.text: Uwo yari afite abakobwa bane b'abāri bahanuraga.

10.text: Tugitinzeyo iminsi, haza umuhanuzi witwaga Agabo avuye i Yudaya.

11.text: Ageze aho turi, yenda umushumi wa Pawulo awibohesha amaguru n'amaboko aravuga ati “Umwuka Wera avuze ngo ‘Nyir'uyu mushumi ni ko Abayuda bazamubohera i Yerusalemu, bamutange mu maboko y'abapagani.’ ”

12.text: Tubyumvise twebwe n'abantu b'aho, turamwinginga ngo atajya i Yerusalemu.

13.text: Ariko Pawulo aratubaza ati “Ni iki gitumye murira mukamena umutima? Uretse kuboherwa i Yerusalemu gusa, niteguye no gupfirayo ku bw'izina ry'Umwami Yesu.”

14.text: Yanze kutwumvira turicecekera tuti “Ibyo Umwami ashaka bibeho.”

15.text: Hanyuma y'iyo minsi dutekera ibintu byacu, turazamuka tujya i Yerusalemu.

16.text: Abigishwa bavuye i Kayisariya turajyana, batugeza kwa Munasoni w'Umunyakupuro wari umwigishwa wa kera, kugira ngo aducumbikire.

17.text: Tugeze i Yerusalemu bene Data batwakirana umunezero.

18.text: Bukeye bwaho Pawulo yinjirana natwe kwa Yakobo, abakuru bose bari bahari.

19.text: Amaze kubaramutsa, abatekerereza ibyo Imana yamuhaye gukora mu banyamahanga byose uko bikurikirana.

20.text: Na bo babyumvise bahimbaza Imana, baramubwira bati “Urareba nawe mwene Data, uburyo abo mu Bayuda bizeye ari ibihumbi byinshi, kandi bose bagira ishyaka ry'amategeko!

21.text: Babwiwe ibyawe, yuko wigisha Abayuda bose bari mu banyamahanga kureka gukurikiza Mose, ukavuga yuko badakwiriye gukeba abana babo cyangwa gukomeza imihango y'Abayuda.

22.text: None tugire dute ko batari bubure kumva yuko waje?

23.text: Nuko genza utya nk'uko tukubwira. Dore dufite abagabo bane bahize umuhigo.

24.text: Ubajyane mwerezwe hamwe, ubatwerere ibikwiriye mwiyogosheshe. Nuko bose bazamenya yuko ibyo bumvaga bakuvuga ari ibinyoma, ahubwo ko nawe ugenza neza witondera amategeko yose.

25.text: Ariko abizeye bo mu banyamahanga bo twanditse ibyo twanoganije, ko birinda ibiterekerejwe ibishushanyo bisengwa, n'amaraso, n'ibinizwe, n'ubusambanyi.”

26.text: Nuko Pawulo ajyana abo bagabo bukeye bwaho berezwa hamwe, yinjirana na bo mu rusengero, avuga igihe iminsi yo kwezwa izashirira, ari bwo igitambo cy'umuntu wese muri bo kizatangwa.

27.text: Nuko iyo minsi irindwi yenda gusohora, Abayuda bavuye muri Asiya bamubonye mu rusengero, batera abantu bose imidugararo baramusumira,

28.text: barasakuza bati “Bagabo ba Isirayeli, nimudutabare! Uyu ni wa muntu wigisha hose abantu bose gusuzugura ubu bwoko n'amategeko n'aha hantu, kandi yazanye n'Abagiriki mu rusengero, ahumanya aha hantu hera.”

29.text: (Babivugiye batyo kuko bari babonye Tirofimo Umunyefeso ari kumwe na we mu murwa, bībwira yuko Pawulo yamujyanye mu rusengero.)

30.text: Umurwa wose uravurungana, abantu baterana birukanka bafata Pawulo, baramukurubana bamukura mu rusengero, uwo mwanya bakinga inzugi.

31.text: Bagishaka kumwica, inkuru igera ku mutware w'ingabo z'abasirikare, yuko i Yerusalemu hose hari hagize imidugararo.

32.text: Muri ako kanya ajyana abasirikare n'abatwara imitwe, amanuka yirukanka abīrohamo. Na bo babonye umutware w'ingabo n'abasirikare, barorera gukubita Pawulo.

33.text: Maze umutware w'ingabo arabegera aramufata, ategeka ko bamubohesha iminyururu ibiri, abaza uwo ari we n'icyo akoze icyo ari cyo.

34.text: Abo mu iteraniro barasakuza, bamwe bavuga bimwe, abandi ibindi. Ananizwa n'urusaku kumenya ukuri, ategeka ko bamujyana mu rugo rw'igihome.

35.text: Ageze ku rwuririro, umujinya w'abantu utuma abasirikare bamuterura,

36.text: kuko abantu benshi babakurikiraga basakuza bati “Mukureho!”

37.text: Benda kumwinjiza mu rugo rw'igihome, Pawulo abaza umutware w'ingabo ati “Ntiwakwemera ko nkubwira ijambo?”Na we aramubaza ati “Uzi Urugiriki?

38.text: Si wowe wa Munyegiputa wagomesheje abantu mu gihe gishize, ukajyana mu butayu abantu b'abicanyi ibihumbi bine?”

39.text: Pawulo aramusubiza ati “Ndi Umuyuda w'i Taruso, ari wo mudugudu w'i Kilikiya w'ikimenywabose, kandi ndakwinginze unkundire mbwire abantu.”

40.text: Aramukundira. Pawulo ahagarara ku rwuririro, amama abantu barahora rwose. Ababwira mu Ruheburayo ati:
